payload.claim: The comment "`tasks_by_repo`, not `tasks_by_spec_id`: the latter carries no `pr_url` ... and the second guard below needs one" was written when exactly one guard below (the `others` overlap check's second clause) read `pr_url`. The diff inserts a brand-new guard (the `own` row check at lines 1194-1199) directly between this comment and that guard, and it too reads `pr_url` on every iteration implicitly via `own["pr_url"]`. The comment is unchanged and now undercounts: a reader mapping "the second guard below" to code structure can no longer tell whether it means the new `own` check or the `others` check's second clause, and the rationale no longer accounts for the new, earlier consumer of `pr_url` that the diff added right beside it.
